tags_v2.description: Characters who are deeply, obsessively in love, often to the point of violence, possessiveness, or psychosis. They may appear sweet, shy, or affectionate at first, but their devotion can lead them to extreme actions—including harming rivals, kidnapping, or even killing to protect or keep their love interest. The term is a combination of "yan" (ヤン, from yanderu, sick or mentally ill) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.name: Kuudere
tags_v2.description: Characters who appear cool, calm, and emotionally detached on the outside, but gradually reveal a warmer, more caring side beneath their composed exterior. They often speak in a flat tone, show little outward emotion, and express affection through subtle actions rather than words. The term is a combination of "kuu" (cool, 冷たい, tsumetai) and "dere" (deredere, デレデレ, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.description: Characters who are deeply, obsessively in love, often to the point of violence, possessiveness, or psychosis. They may appear sweet, shy, or affectionate at first, but their devotion can lead them to extreme actions—including harming rivals, kidnapping, or even killing to protect or keep their love interest. The term is a combination of "yan" (ヤン, from yanderu, sick or mentally ill) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.name: Hikikomori
tags_v2.description: Characters who have withdrawn from social life, often isolating themselves in their homes (or rooms) for months or years at a time, avoiding face-to-face interaction and displaying extreme social anxiety or apathy toward the outside world. The term is a combination of "hiki" (withdraw, 引き) and "komoru" (seclude, 籠る).

tags_v2.name: Tsundere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are initially cold, hostile, or prickly toward others (especially love interests), but gradually or occasionally reveal a softer, warmer, or caring side beneath their abrasive exterior. The term is a combination of "tsun" (ツンツン, tsuntsun, aloof or prickly) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.name: Kuudere
tags_v2.description: Characters who appear cool, calm, and emotionally detached on the outside, but gradually reveal a warmer, more caring side beneath their composed exterior. They often speak in a flat tone, show little outward emotion, and express affection through subtle actions rather than words. The term is a combination of "kuu" (cool, 冷たい, tsumetai) and "dere" (deredere, デレデレ, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.name: Tsundere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are initially cold, hostile, or prickly toward others (especially love interests), but gradually or occasionally reveal a softer, warmer, or caring side beneath their abrasive exterior. Regularly appears in japanese media as "Newhalf" (from, Fakku):
> Vogue term used primarily in the entertainment industries often used interchangeably to describe gender nonconforming men who present as female, and some trans women who choose to identify as such. Essentially “half man, half woman”.
